title: One invitation-link type shared by the server and the client
spec: crewcraft_enroll::invitation::InvitationLink is the one invitation-link type: crewcraft://enroll?server=<host:port>&code=<code>&root_sha256=<hex>. parse(&str) compares the scheme and path exactly, needs server, code and root_sha256 each exactly once and nothing else (no empty parameter, no fragment), allows only unreserved characters, ':' and percent escapes in values and decodes them once to UTF-8, reads the server as host:port (a lowercase DNS name, an IPv4 address or an IPv6 address in brackets; port 1 to 65535 with no sign or leading zero; unspecified, multicast and broadcast refused), the code with EnrollmentCode::parse and the fingerprint as 64 hex digits. Display writes the same form (values percent-encoded, brackets as %5B and %5D, the code in display form, the fingerprint in lowercase). Debug never prints the code; the decoded code text is wiped, and EnrollmentCode wipes its bytes on drop. The server's enrollment_link writes through the same writer, and invitation commands show a link built as InvitationLink, so a link the client would refuse is never shown. The test round-trips links, refuses every malformed variant with its reason, and parses links from the server's writer.
